display_title: His Majesty the Grand Prince's Master
description:
Sakwol, who was of lowly status, was taken in by Grand Prince Sibaek, and became close to him as a servant and companion. Sakwol admired Sibaek and followed him, but one day he was suddenly abandoned. After that, a great upheaval occurred, and the world was in chaos due to ghosts, and the previous order and rules collapsed. Sakwol awakens as a strong 'guardian' and deals with ghosts, and the people follow him instead of the king. While eliminating the incompetent royal relatives, Sibaek is captured in front of Sakwol. "I make this Sibaek my slave." Sakwol's hatred shows its teeth.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.*
